vision.statement: Enable every community health worker in Uganda to access trusted, interoperable patient data through a secure national platform.
vision.mission: Design, build, and deploy the Da'atSNA Community Data Platform connecting clinics, NHIS, and ministry systems within 12 months.

objectives.description: Deliver FHIR-compliant data exchange between 50 pilot clinics
objectives.measurable_criteria: 50 clinics live by Q4; 99% uptime SLA

objectives.description: Reduce patient record retrieval time for CHWs
Train 200 community health workers on the platform
objectives.measurable_criteria: 200 certified users; 80% adoption in pilot districts

in_scope: FHIR API gateway and patient demographics module
Clinic onboarding portal and CHW mobile interface
scope.boundaries: Platform terminates at approved ministry firewall endpoints; clinics connect via VPN or approved cloud links.

constraints: Must comply with Uganda Data Protection and Health Information regulations
Total budget capped at USD 59,400 for Phase 1
All production releases require sponsor sign-off
assumptions: Existing NHIS APIs remain stable through project duration
Pilot clinics provide dedicated IT liaisons
Cloud infrastructure procured within first 60 days
Ministry security review completes before go-live
success_criteria: 50 clinics connected with verified data exchange
200 CHWs trained and actively using the platform
Zero critical security findings at go-live audit
